summary: The code is the same as in round 3, which I approved, now rebased onto the new base 5c6590cb. I found no new source or test defects. I still cannot approve, because the durable suite never ran: `test/ControlPlane.test.ts` failed at import with `Cannot find module 'lodash'`, which `node_modules/tuple-database/helpers/randomId.js` requires. This points to a stale install after the rebase, not to this change. Because nothing ran, `AppGateway.ts` 9 and `publicAppPage.ts` 22-23 show as uncovered. The report also exempts `AppGateway.ts` 190-209 using the database-outage exemption comment from line 168, which belongs to the viewer-error branch, so I don't accept those exemptions. Run `pnpm install` so the workspace dependencies are complete, then rerun the durable suite; the existing durable tests (the banner page, iframe routing, HEAD request and visibility checks) should cover these lines.

testRequests.target: apps/control-plane/test/ControlPlane.test.ts: rerun the durable suite after reinstalling dependencies, so the publicAppTest cases load and cover AppGateway.ts:9, the banner-page branch at AppGateway.ts:190-209, and the HEAD branch at publicAppPage.ts:22-23
